# Carnot Cycle Circus - LLM System Specification & Context Map

> High-density machine-readable technical overview for LLMs, autonomous coding agents, and automated tools.

## 1. System Metadata
- **Project**: Carnot Cycle Circus (Autonomous Engineering Agent Orchestration Platform)
- **Runtime**: .NET 10.0 (C# 13)
- **UI Framework**: ASP.NET Core Blazor (Interactive Server Components)
- **Test Framework**: xUnit 2.9+, FluentAssertions 8.0+
- **Solution File**: `CarnotCycleCircus.slnx`
- **Solution Architecture**: Layered DDD / Autonomous Agent Multi-Role Orchestrator

---

## 2. Core Architectural Invariants & Constraints

### 2.1 Deliverable Isolation Contract (MANDATORY)
- **Banter vs Deliverable**: Agents have witty/cynical personas in conversational chat/thought messages, BUT all delivered artifacts (PRDs, ADRs, C# code, STRIDE models, Benchmark reports, QA scorecards, tickets) MUST remain 100% professional, rigorous, standard-compliant, unambiguous, and free of sarcastic or joke content.
- **Enforcement**: See ADR-0005 (`docs/adrs/0005-deliverable-isolation-contract-for-agent-personas.md`).

### 2.2 Immutability & Type Design
- **Domain Models & DTOs**: MUST be declared as immutable C# `record` types (`TicketItem`, `HandoffPacket`, `AgentPersona`, `MemoryEntry`, `GraphNode`, `ArchitecturalDecisionRecord`).
- **Value Objects / Identifiers**: MUST be declared as `readonly record struct` or immutable primitives.
- **State Transitions**: MUST use non-destructive mutation (`with { ... }`).

### 2.3 Performance & Allocation Dogma
- **Zero Allocations on Hot Paths**: Use `ReadOnlyMemory<byte>`, `ReadOnlySpan<char>`, `ValueTask`, and bounded `Channel<T>` buffers.
- **Asynchronous Execution**: Every async method MUST accept `CancellationToken cancellationToken = default` and pass it down.
- **Thread Safety**: All in-memory stores MUST use `ConcurrentDictionary<TKey, TValue>`, `ConcurrentQueue<T>`, or thread-safe atomic primitives.

---

| Role (`AgentRole` enum) | Persona Name | Default Model | Allowed Tools | Primary Deliverables |
| :--- | :--- | :--- | :--- | :--- |
| `TechnicalProductManager` | Barnum B. Buzzword (TPM) | `openai/gpt-4o` | `web_search`, `memory_lookup` | PRD markdown, Epics, User Stories, Acceptance Criteria |
| `LeadArchitect` | Archduke Archibald Abstraction-o (Lead Arch) | `anthropic/claude-3.7-sonnet` | `web_search`, `csharp_syntax_check`, `memory_lookup`, `adr_writer` | ADRs (MADR/Nygard), C4 Diagrams, Domain Boundaries, Technical Subtasks |
| `SoftwareDeveloper` | Devon "Coldbrew" Crashdump (Senior Dev) | `qwen/qwen-2.5-coder-32b-instruct` | `csharp_syntax_check`, `test_runner`, `memory_lookup` | C# 13 source code, zero-allocation services, xUnit test suites |
| `SecurityEngineer` | Sari "Tinfoil" Sandbox (Security Eng) | `openai/o3-mini` | `web_search`, `csharp_syntax_check`, `memory_lookup` | STRIDE threat models, vulnerability audits, secret leak checks |
| `OptimizationEngineer` | Otto-Cycle Overclock (Optimization Eng) | `anthropic/claude-3.7-sonnet` | `csharp_syntax_check`, `test_runner`, `memory_lookup` | BenchmarkDotNet reports, latency audits, allocation profiles |
| `PrincipalQAAnalyst` | Quinn the Build-Executioner (Principal QA) | `deepseek/deepseek-r1` | `test_runner`, `memory_lookup`, `csharp_syntax_check` | Test strategies, boundary matrices, quality scorecards, certification |

## 4. Key Subsystems & Interfaces

### 4.1 Ticket & Work Decomposition Engine (`CarnotCycleCircus.Core.Domain.Tickets`)
- `ITicketStore`: In-memory thread-safe ticket and handoff repository.
  - `CreateTicket(TicketItem)`, `UpdateTicket(TicketItem)`, `GetReadyTickets()`, `AreDependenciesSatisfied(string ticketId)`, `RecordHandoff(HandoffPacket)`.
- `IWorkDecompositionEngine`:
  - `DeconstructEpic(title, desc, priority)`: TPM creates Epic + Story 1; Architect creates 5 technical subtasks (Arch, Dev, Security, Opt, QA) with strict DAG dependency edges.
  - `DeconstructStoryIntoTechnicalSubtasks(story)`: Generates DAG subtasks.
- `IHandoffRouter`:
  - `RouteSuccessHandoff(...)`: Dispatches structured `HandoffPacket` to next agent and advances DAG.
  - `RouteFailureRemediation(...)`: Emits remediation packet and transitions ticket to `TicketStatus.Remediating` assigned to fixing role (e.g. Developer).
  - `AdvanceWorkflowOnTicketCompletion(ticketId)`: Evaluates downstream dependencies; transitions satisfied tickets to `TicketStatus.Ready`.

### 4.2 Hierarchical Persistent Memory (`CarnotCycleCircus.Core.Domain.Memory`)
- `IPersistentMemoryStore` / `EmbeddedVectorMemoryStore`:
  - 4 Memory Types: `Working` (scratchpad), `Episodic` (task completions), `Semantic` (patterns/concepts), `Procedural` (workflows).
  - Embedded vector embedding: 64-dimensional normalized word-hash embeddings with composite cosine similarity + token overlap + importance weighting.
  - Methods: `StoreAsync`, `SearchAsync(query, topK, typeFilter, roleFilter)`, `PruneAsync`, `GetAllAsync`.
- `IMemoryConsolidationEngine`: Automatically consolidates completed tickets and telemetry into episodic memories.
- `IContextAwareMemoryInjector`: Injects relevant hierarchical memory chunks into role prompts.
- `IExternalMemoryConnector`: REST bridge for syncing with external vector stores (OpenViking, Mem0, Qdrant).

### 4.3 Connectable Workflow Graph (`CarnotCycleCircus.Core.Domain.Graph`)
- `WorkflowGraph`: Node/Edge DAG with explicit ports:
  - `PortType.Input` (🟢)
  - `PortType.Output` (🔵 Success)
  - `PortType.Failure` (🔴 Reject/Remediation loopback)
- `IGraphWorkflowExecutor`:
  - `ExecuteWorkflowAsync(epicTitle, epicDesc, triggerFailureSimulation, ct)`: Runs full lifecycle through TPM $\to$ Arch $\to$ Dev $\to$ Sec & Opt (parallel) $\to$ QA $\to$ Release.
  - `StepNextNodeAsync(ct)`: Executes the next pending ready ticket in single-step mode.
  - Circuit Breakers: Configurable `FailurePolicy` tripping on excessive retries.

### 4.4 Cryptographic Security, Key Vault & Inference (`CarnotCycleCircus.Core.Domain.Security`, `Inference`)
- `ISecureKeyEncryptor` / `AesGcmKeyEncryptor`: Authenticated AES-256-GCM AEAD envelope encryption with 96-bit nonces, 128-bit integrity tags, associated authenticated data (AAD) context binding, and zero-allocation span operations.
- `IMasterKeyProvider` / `MasterKeyProvider`: Multi-tier master encryption key derivation (Environment Variable -> Host-bound `.carnot.master.key` (0600) -> PBKDF2-HMAC-SHA256 310k iterations -> In-memory ephemeral).
- `IApiKeyVaultService`: Encrypted-at-rest credential storage (`keys.vault.json`), key rotation (`RotateMasterKeyAsync`), passphrase-encrypted export/import (`ExportEncryptedVaultAsync` / `ImportEncryptedVaultAsync`), active key swapping, legacy `keys.json` migration, and security health audit.
- `IOpenRouterClient`: Multi-model chat completion client with fallback to local simulation mode when using sandbox/mock keys.
- `IAgentInferenceResolver`: Resolves effective model and API key per agent member with team inheritance.
- `ISimulatedScenarioEngine`: Orchestrates live inference and deterministic offline fallbacks:
  - **Multi-File Deliverable Parsing**: Parses ````csharp:FileName.cs```` code blocks into modular multi-file bundles (Interfaces, Services, DI Extensions, and Unit Tests).
  - **Autonomous Syntax Self-Healing**: Runs `CSharpSyntaxCheckTool` on generated code, automatically triggering targeted remediation prompts if syntax errors are detected.
  - **Upstream Context Continuity**: Recursively aggregates deliverables (`GatherUpstreamDeliverables`) from parent Epics (PRDs) and upstream dependency tickets (ADRs, source code, unit tests) and injects them into downstream prompts.
  - **Repository Context**: Injects solution structure, target namespaces, and detected patterns from `ICodebaseHarvesterService`.

### 4.5 Deliverables & Artifacts Hub (`CarnotCycleCircus.Core.Domain.Artifacts`)
- `IArtifactManager` / `ArtifactManager`: Manages lifecycle, categorization, and repository disk synchronization of agent deliverables.
  - 6 Primary Categories: `PRD` (purple), `ADR` (blue), `Code` (green), `Security` (red), `Benchmark` (amber), `QA` (pink).
  - Methods: `SaveDeliverableArtifactAsync`, `ExportAllDeliverablesAsync`, `GetAllArtifacts`, `GetArtifactsByCategory`, `GetArtifactsByRole`.
  - Auto-exports deliverables to categorised disk folders (`artifacts/prds`, `artifacts/adrs`, `artifacts/code`, `artifacts/security`, `artifacts/benchmarks`, `artifacts/qa`).

### 4.6 Tool Sandbox (`CarnotCycleCircus.Core.Domain.Tools`)
- `IToolDefinition`: Interface exposing `Name`, `Description`, `ParameterSchema`, and `ExecuteAsync(ToolExecutionContext, CancellationToken)`.
- Standard Tools: `web_search`, `csharp_syntax_check`, `test_runner`, `adr_writer`, `memory_lookup`.

### 4.7 ADR & Documentation Hub (`CarnotCycleCircus.Core.Domain.Docs`)
- `IAdrDocumentManager`: Manages ADRs (MADR/Nygard format) and Project Documents (C4 diagrams, STRIDE models). Exports complete markdown documentation bundles.

### 4.8 Standards & Quality Gates (`CarnotCycleCircus.Core.Domain.Standards`)
- `IStandardsValidator`: Enforces quality gate policies: minimum coverage, unit tests for features, root cause analysis (RCA) + regression tests for bugs, and ADRs for epics.

### 4.9 AI Knowledge Maps (`CarnotCycleCircus.Core.Domain.Knowledge`)
- `IKnowledgeMapService`: Graph of `KnowledgeNode` and `KnowledgeEdge` items (Concepts, Patterns, SecurityRules, AntiPatterns, LearnedInsights) with sub-graph query extraction for LLM prompt augmentation.

### 4.10 Skills Registry (`CarnotCycleCircus.Core.Domain.Skills`)
- `ISkillRegistry` & `ISkillImporter`: Parses `SKILL.md` frontmatter, JSON, or remote URLs; manages role-to-skill assignment matrix.

### 4.11 Real-Time Telemetry Stream (`CarnotCycleCircus.Core.Domain.Events`)
- `IAgentEventStream`: In-memory thread-safe pub/sub bus publishing `AgentMessage` items (Chat, Thought, ToolCall, ToolOutput, Handoff, StateChange, Alert, ArtifactCreated) with bounded 1,000-message buffer.

### 4.12 Project Blueprints, Harvester & Showcase (`CarnotCycleCircus.Core.Domain.Blueprints`, `Harvester`, `Showcase`)
- `IProjectBlueprintService`: 1-click curated architectural blueprints (IoT Ingestion, E-Commerce Saga, Zero-Trust Identity, Distributed CQRS, Chaos Benchmark Arena) and custom project ignition. Auto-decomposes Epics, registers initial ADRs, populates knowledge maps, and switches squad archetype.
- `ICodebaseHarvesterService`: Scans local solutions/directories, discovers project boundaries, extracts dependencies, detects architecture patterns, audits tech debt, and generates prioritized improvement tickets.
- `IShowcaseDemoService`: Zero-setup 1-click interactive demo runner for live swarm execution, failure remediation loopbacks, and nanosecond optimization benchmarking without API keys.

---
